canonical_name: Ceva's theorem for a Euclidean triangle (exact direction, ratio convention, and boundary policy open)
category: 几何学 / 欧几里得几何
literal_source_claim_en: A ratio relation for concurrent lines.
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For one source-selected point on each opposite side or sideline of a nondegenerate ordered Euclidean triangle, the three cevians are concurrent if and only if a source-selected cyclic product of directed or unsigned side ratios is one.

The inspected modern lead states an iff with signed extensions, whereas every direct pinned triangle-product candidate proves only concurrency implies a product identity. Selecting either scope at intake would silently decide proposition-changing clauses without independent review.
